description: End-to-end feedback-driven lifecycle for configuring, monitoring, and continuously improving a SASE (Secure Access Service Edge) connectivity service in a TaaS environment.

tenant_id.description: Unique tenant or customer account identifier

sase_profile_id.description: Identifier for a SASE policy/profile configuration

edge_site_id.description: Identifier for a SASE edge site/POP or branch location

connection_id.description: Identifier for a secure connectivity session or tunnel

policy_id.description: Identifier for an individual security or routing policy object

feedback_id.description: Identifier for a user or system feedback record related to SASE experience

incident_id.description: Identifier for a detected incident or anomaly

change_request_id.description: Identifier for a change request generated from feedback or optimization suggestions

baseline_id.description: Identifier for a saved baseline configuration snapshot

functions.name: create_sase_profile
functions.description: Create a new SASE service profile with initial connectivity, security, and QoS settings for a tenant.

tenant_id.description: Tenant to which this SASE profile belongs.

name.description: Human-friendly name of the SASE profile.

description.description: Detailed description of the intended use, sites, and users.

topology_type.description: Overall logical topology between edge sites.

transport_options.description: Supported underlay transports for this SASE profile.

max_bandwidth_mbps.description: Maximum aggregate bandwidth per site for this transport.

tunnel_defaults.description: Default tunnel parameters applied to connections created under this profile.

default_policy_set.description: Default firewall and SWG policies applied to traffic.

app_classes.description: Application classes and their priority tiers.

tags.description: Arbitrary key-value tags for categorizing profiles.

functions.returns: Created SASE profile with sase_profile_id, summary configuration, and initial status.

functions.name: get_sase_profile
functions.description: Retrieve detailed information for a SASE profile, including associated edge sites, policies, and baselines.
functions.returns: Full SASE profile details and any requested related entities.

functions.name: list_sase_profiles
functions.description: List and filter SASE profiles for a given tenant, with pagination and sorting.

tenant_id.description: Tenant whose SASE profiles should be listed.

functions.returns: Paginated list of SASE profiles and counts.

functions.name: provision_edge_site
functions.description: Provision and attach a new edge site (branch, POP, user pool) to a SASE profile.

sase_profile_id.description: Profile under which this edge site will be provisioned.

site.description: Core attributes of the edge site.

connectivity_profile.description: Overrides or extends the profile-level connectivity configuration.

initial_policies.description: Optional initial policy objects to attach specifically to this site.

inline_definition.description: Optional inline policy body for site-specific policies.

auto_connect.description: If true, automatically create standard connections for this site after provisioning.

functions.returns: Provisioned edge_site_id, status, and any auto-created connection_ids.

functions.name: create_connection
functions.description: Create a secure SASE connection/tunnel between edge sites or from a user pool to a SASE POP.

pop_region.description: Region code for SASE POP destinations.

saas_app_id.description: SaaS application identifier for direct access.

schedule.description: Schedule parameters when activation_mode is scheduled.

functions.returns: Created connection_id, activation status, and resolved path details.

functions.name: monitor_connection_health
functions.description: Retrieve live or recent health metrics for one or more connections, edge sites, or a whole SASE profile.

time_window.description: Time window to query metrics over.

metrics.description: List of health metrics to include.

include_incidents.description: Whether to include correlated incidents/anomalies in the response.

functions.returns: Time series metrics, aggregated KPIs, and optionally related incident_ids.

functions.name: submit_sase_feedback
functions.description: Submit qualitative and quantitative feedback about SASE connectivity experience from end-users or automated probes.

source_context.description: Context about where the feedback originated.

experience_rating.description: Overall experience score on a 1-10 scale.

metadata.description: Additional arbitrary metadata from clients or probes.

functions.returns: Created feedback_id and any immediately detected correlations to incidents or connections.

functions.name: analyze_feedback_and_generate_recommendations
functions.description: Analyze collected feedback, correlate with telemetry, and produce optimization recommendations and optional change requests.

feedback_ids.description: Specific feedback records to analyze (required if scope is feedback).

tenant_id.description: Tenant to analyze (required if scope is tenant).

sase_profile_id.description: SASE profile to analyze (required if scope is sase_profile).

analysis_window.description: Time window for including telemetry and incidents.

include.description: Additional content in the analysis result.

risk_tolerance.description: How bold recommendations should be when trading off security vs. performance.

functions.returns: List of optimization recommendations, mapped feedback_ids, incident_ids, and optionally generated change_request_ids.

functions.name: create_change_request_from_recommendation
functions.description: Create a concrete SASE change request from one or more optimization recommendations, linking to profiles, policies, and connections.

recommendations.description: Recommendations to materialize into a change request.

proposed_changes.description: Polymorphic object describing what to change.

change_ticket.description: Administrative details to track and approve this change.

auto_approve.description: If true, mark the change request as approved and ready for apply when policy allows.

functions.returns: Created change_request_id, initial status, and a summary of planned changes.

functions.name: apply_change_request
functions.description: Apply an approved SASE change request with optional pre-change baseline capture and dry-run validation.

apply_mode.description: Whether to simulate, roll out gradually, or apply fully.

batch_size.description: Number of edge sites or connections per batch.

create_baseline.description: Capture a configuration baseline for rollback before applying changes.

notes.description: Operator notes about this apply operation.

functions.returns: Apply job status, optional baseline_id, affected entities, and next recommended monitoring actions.

functions.name: rollback_sase_baseline
functions.description: Rollback SASE configuration to a previously captured baseline, optionally scoped to specific edge sites or connections.

baseline_id.description: Baseline snapshot identifier to roll back to.

scope.description: Optional scope to limit the rollback to a subset of the configuration.

reason.description: Reason for rollback (e.g., regression, outage, feedback).

confirm_rollback.description: Must be true to proceed with rollback.

functions.returns: Rollback execution status, newly created baseline_id (post-rollback), and validation summary.

functions.name: retry_connection_optimization
functions.description: Retry automated optimization for a degraded connection, optionally adjusting constraints based on prior failures.

connection_id.description: Connection on which to retry optimization.

incident_id.description: Associated incident originally triggering optimization (if any).

last_attempt_context.description: Context from the last optimization attempt for this connection.

dry_run.description: If true, only simulate the optimization and return a proposal.

functions.returns: Optimization retry status, proposed or applied changes, and updated incident or feedback linkage.

functions.name: close_feedback_loop
functions.description: Close the feedback loop by updating feedback state, notifying stakeholders, and optionally collecting follow-up feedback after changes.

feedback_id.description: Feedback record to close the loop on.

linked_entities.description: Entities used to address this feedback.

communication_plan.description: How and when to communicate back to the feedback source.

follow_up_window_hours.description: When to prompt for follow-up experience rating.

internal_notes.description: Operator notes documenting the resolution and learnings.

functions.returns: Updated feedback record, notification dispatch status, and optionally a new feedback_id for scheduled follow-up.

functions.name: bulk_import_sase_profiles
functions.description: Bulk-import multiple sase_profiles from an upstream source with validation and idempotency keys.

mapping.description: Field mapping from source to canonical schema

functions.returns: A bulk-import job descriptor with counts of accepted, rejected, and quarantined sase_profiles, plus a job_id for follow-up.

functions.name: bulk_update_sase_profiles
functions.description: Apply a partial update to a batch of sase_profiles matched by filter or id list.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

patch.description: Fields to patch on each matched item

functions.returns: Summary of matched, updated, and skipped sase_profiles with per-item error details.

functions.name: bulk_archive_sase_profiles
functions.description: Archive (soft-delete) a batch of sase_profiles with retention metadata and audit reasons.
functions.returns: Per-id archive results with new lifecycle state.

functions.name: bulk_export_sase_profiles
functions.description: Export a filtered set of sase_profiles to a downstream destination (S3, GCS, blob, SFTP).

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Export job handle including job_id, expected object URIs, row count, and signed download URLs when applicable.

functions.name: search_sase_profiles_advanced
functions.description: Advanced faceted search across sase_profiles with full-text, structured filters, aggregations, and sort.

query.description: Full-text query string with Lucene-like syntax

functions.returns: Search response with sase_profiles hits, total count, aggregation buckets, and a next-cursor.

functions.name: create_sase_profile_subscription
functions.description: Create a subscription that fires webhooks or notifications on sase_profile lifecycle events.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: The created subscription including subscription_id, active state, and last_delivery info (initially null).

functions.name: list_sase_profile_subscriptions
functions.description: List existing sase_profile subscriptions with optional filters and pagination.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated list of subscription objects including delivery health stats.

functions.name: deactivate_sase_profile_subscription
functions.description: Deactivate or delete a sase_profile subscription and optionally flush pending deliveries.
functions.returns: Updated subscription state and the number of pending deliveries flushed or kept.

functions.name: get_sase_profile_audit_log
functions.description: Return the audit/change log for a single sase_profile with field-level diffs and actor info.

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Chronological list of audit events with before/after diffs, actor, and source IP/system.

functions.name: search_audit_events
functions.description: Search audit events across sase_profiles for compliance and forensic review.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated audit-event hits with cross-entity references.

functions.name: schedule_sase_profile_job
functions.description: Create a recurring schedule that triggers a named operation on a target set of sase_profiles.

operation.description: Named operation to invoke (e.g., refresh, recompute, export, reconcile)

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: The created scheduled-job descriptor with job_id, next_run_at, and current status.

functions.name: list_sase_profile_jobs
functions.description: List scheduled or in-flight jobs related to sase_profiles with status filtering and pagination.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated list of sase_profile jobs and their last run summaries.

functions.name: cancel_sase_profile_job
functions.description: Cancel a scheduled or in-flight sase_profile job, optionally interrupting running steps.
functions.returns: Updated job status with cancellation timestamp and any side effects.

functions.name: simulate_sase_profile_change
functions.description: Simulate a proposed change against a sase_profile (or batch) without committing; returns expected diffs and warnings.
functions.returns: Simulation result with predicted diffs, rule violations, cost/SLA impact, and a confidence score.

functions.name: request_sase_profile_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a sensitive sase_profile change requiring reviewer sign-off.
functions.returns: Created approval request with approval_request_id, current state, and notification targets.

functions.name: submit_sase_profile_approval_decision
functions.description: Submit an approve, reject, or request-changes decision against a sase_profile approval request.
functions.returns: Updated approval request state including quorum progress and final decision (if reached).

functions.name: add_sase_profile_comment
functions.description: Append a comment or annotation to a sase_profile, optionally attaching files or mentioning users.
functions.returns: The created comment object with comment_id, timestamps, and visibility-resolved permissions.

functions.name: list_sase_profile_comments
functions.description: List comments and annotations attached to a sase_profile, with optional thread expansion.
functions.returns: Paginated comment list with thread tree and attachment metadata.

functions.name: snapshot_sase_profile
functions.description: Create a point-in-time immutable snapshot of a sase_profile for forensic, rollback, or compliance use.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor with snapshot_id, checksum, byte size, and retention expiry.

functions.name: restore_sase_profile_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a sase_profile from a previously created snapshot, optionally as a new copy.
functions.returns: Restore job descriptor including resulting id and any per-field conflicts that were resolved.

functions.name: get_sase_profile_metrics
functions.description: Compute KPI metrics over sase_profiles (counts, MTTR, SLA compliance, error rates) for a time window.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Time-bucketed metric series and aggregate KPIs for the matched sase_profiles.

functions.name: build_sase_profile_dashboard
functions.description: Persist a named dashboard composed of widgets (charts, tables, single-stat) over sase_profiles data.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Created dashboard descriptor with dashboard_id, shareable URL, and computed first-render preview.

functions.name: upsert_sase_profile_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule used to govern sase_profile behavior, validation, or routing.
functions.returns: Persisted policy with policy_id, version, rule count, and validation warnings (if any).

functions.name: list_sase_profile_policies
functions.description: List policies governing sase_profiles with version, scope, and lifecycle filters.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated policy entries with rule counts and last evaluation metrics.

functions.name: link_sase_profile_dependencies
functions.description: Establish or update dependency links between a sase_profile and related artefacts.
functions.returns: Updated dependency graph summary with added/removed/updated edges.
